title: Send Collected Watch Data to Phone via Wifi, if watch and the phone are on the same Wifi network?
body: If the watch and phone are on the same wifi network, can the watch collect and send readings over wifi to the phone, even if the phone is far away from the watch (school campus? or big house? etc.)

comments.body: Yes, I tested the Cloud feature of Android Wear several months and confirmed it worked as expected.  Doesn't matter the distance between phone and watch, could be different cities!  The phone, of course, must be turned on and have Wi-Fi enabled.  Of course, the watch must be paired with that phone and be set as the xDrip+ collector, also.
This sounds amazing if it works. I'll have the SW3 this week and can test.  Thanks for your reply.  I was not aware this feature was implemented.

This works fine. I have used a Huawei Watch 2 with 4G as a collector hundreds of miles away from the phone which it is paired with. Any combination of mobile data / wifi / bluetooth connectivity appears to work in my tests.

Are there any special settings on the watch or phone that I need to enable
to make this work?
